scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun run build:server && bun run build:cli
scripts.build:server: cd apps/server && bun build src/index.ts --outdir ../../packages/cli/dist/server --format esm --target node --external @libsql/client --external @libsql/* --external drizzle-orm --external drizzle-orm/* --external node-pty --external ws
scripts.deploy:test: cd apps/web && bun run build && bun run ../../packages/cli/bin/kite.js push --token test-token --server http://localhost:5431
